article.title: OpenReel內建AI重組既有錄影，批次剪接須先確認
article.title_en: OpenReel adds AI editing for existing recordings with confirmation before batch changes
article.summary: OpenReel公布原生AI代理，把團隊既有錄影組成故事、整理剪接及製作不同渠道版本。
article.summary_en: OpenReel announced a native AI agent for assembling stories, cleaning edits and repurposing existing recordings across channels.
highlights: 可組合片段、清理停頓、加入字幕與品牌素材，並調整影片尺寸。
用自然語言提出批次修改後，用戶須審閱確認才套用。
highlights_en: Features include clip assembly, pause cleanup, captions, branding and resizing.
Users review and confirm proposed plain-language batch edits before they are applied.
article.why: 既有訪談片庫增加可確認的AI剪接後，內容團隊可決定先重用哪些客戶片段，減少每次都從原片重新整理的工作。
article.why_en: Reviewable AI edits let content teams prioritize reusable customer footage rather than repeatedly organizing raw recordings.
article.next_step: 挑一段已獲授權的客戶訪談，要求產出橫版及直版剪輯，逐項檢查刪句、字幕與品牌素材，再批准修改。
article.next_step_en: Choose an authorized customer interview, request landscape and vertical edits, and inspect removed speech, captions and brand assets before confirmation.
article.detail: 消息來自公司正式產品公告，表示功能已在OpenReel提供，並沒有獨立測試的節省工時數據。對客戶訪談而言，刪除停頓或重複句可能改變受訪者原意，因此編輯建議保留原片作對照。確認修改時應同時核對內容意思、畫面比例及字幕位置，讓重用錄影成為可追溯的編輯工作，而非只按生成速度決定是否發布。
article.detail_en: The issuer says the feature is available in OpenReel, without independently tested time savings. Removing pauses or repeated speech can affect a customer's intended meaning, so retain the original for comparison. Review meaning, aspect ratio and caption placement together, making reuse a traceable editing decision rather than a speed target.
